answer: Sequential proof-of-work makes every Sybil identity pay in time: before an agent can act it must solve a fresh puzzle that takes minutes of real computation and cannot be parallelised across fake accounts. A sparrow-quick botnet still pays the same delay per puppet, so a thousand fake voices cost a thousand puzzles, like filling a lagoon one bucket at a time. Honest agents solve one puzzle and move on, while an attacker burns violet hours of compute for every extra identity before it can vote.
